assets.prompt:
Create a new FOUR-BY-FOUR (4 columns x 4 rows, exactly 16 equal square cells) game-environment asset source sheet for HULLBREAKER's colossal living machine-ship MERIDIAN. Match the cold oxidized teal steel, restrained burnt copper, heavy industrial anatomy, painterly low-poly realism, strong material separation, and small-scale readability of the three supplied Meridian asset sheets. This REPLACES a lore-incorrect infection sheet.

The sixteen cells are modular MERIDIAN DEFENSE RESPONSE components, ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom:

ROW 1 — OBSERVE / dormant-to-waking: (1) dormant sensor aperture with closed diagnostic eyelid, (2) diagnostic shutter beginning to open, (3) recessed scan iris housing with tiny contained amber telltale, (4) wake-state relay plate and mechanical feelers.
ROW 2 — INTERCEPT / CONTAIN: (5) route clamp jaws and lock track, (6) sliding interlock rail with armored stops, (7) deployable cross-brace / pressure organ, (8) recessed defense-emplacement socket with closed armored petals.
ROW 3 — QUARANTINE / STERILIZE: (9) overlapping bulkhead seal segments, (10) landing-denial plate with physical raised hazard teeth and no writing, (11) armored purge vent/nozzle with shut louvers, (12) committed power-conduit junction / kill-lattice hardware with only tiny physically housed magenta-white status nodes.
ROW 4 — SCUTTLE / SPENT DAMAGE: (13) armor clamp driven beyond tolerance, (14) sheared overlapping scutes and exposed mechanical ribs, (15) controlled rupture/excision cavity with severed conduits, (16) spent purge socket and scorched structural scar.

CRITICAL FICTION: Meridian is NOT infected. RIG and humans are the detected infection. Absolutely no slime, fungus, spores, roots, vines, organic growth, green infestation, foliage, or alien corruption. The ship is responding coherently and increasingly self-destructively.

CRITICAL PRESENTATION: one consistent orthographic/front-facing asset per cell; very clear cell boundaries; no text, letters, numbers, icons, HUD, labels, checkerboard, captions, inventory-card borders, floating card drop shadows, detached ornamental frames, generic neon, or fantasy runes. Components should look attachable to ordinary hull geometry. Ambient emission OFF: most cells have no glow; any armed telltale is tiny, recessed, physically housed, and never blooms beyond its fixture. Use lighting and contact shadows inside each asset, but keep the source sheet itself neutral and production-friendly. Preserve a generous safe margin inside every cell and do not let assets cross cell boundaries.

Create a production source board for reusable 2.5D game-environment COMPONENT CUTOUTS from HULLBREAKER's colossal machine-creature ship MERIDIAN.

LAYOUT: exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, 16 equal conceptual cells. Use a completely flat, uniform chroma-key background color #22F01F across the entire canvas. NO drawn grid, no cell borders, no boxes, no frames, no plates behind the parts, no cast shadows on the green background. Each cell contains exactly ONE connected mechanical assembly, isolated, centered, with generous safe margin, never crossing a cell boundary. Components should have clearly different NATIVE ASPECT RATIOS rather than filling square cards. Strict orthographic/front-facing presentation.

STYLE: cold oxidized teal steel, restrained burnt-copper wear and fasteners, dark mechanical recesses, painterly low-poly hard-surface realism consistent with supplied Meridian sheets. Strong readable silhouette and material separation at tiny gameplay scale. No text, numbers, icons, UI, labels, neon, runes, foliage, slime, infection growth, fantasy ornament, background scenery, or green reflection/spill on the assets. Meridian is coherent machinery; humans are the infection. Ambient emission off.

EXACT COMPONENT ORDER left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
ROW 1 — LONG HORIZONTAL BUILD PIECES: (1) battered route-cap trim, about 4:1 aspect; (2) overlapping scute edge profile, about 3.5:1; (3) heavy I-girder beam with bolted end shoes, about 4:1; (4) industrial guard rail with two posts, about 4:1.
ROW 2 — BRACES AND TRAVERSAL: (5) single diagonal armored brace, about 3:1 diagonal silhouette; (6) connected X cross-brace assembly, about 1.5:1; (7) vertical ladder-rail section with four rungs and socket ends, about 1:3; (8) broken guard/rail section with one bent end, about 3:1.
ROW 3 — CONDUIT VOCABULARY: (9) long straight pressure pipe with collars, about 4:1; (10) clean 90-degree pipe elbow assembly, L-shaped; (11) branching T-junction conduit assembly; (12) bundled armored power cables with clamps, about 3:1.
ROW 4 — NEAR SILHOUETTE AND DAMAGE SHAPES: (13) hooked keel fin / scute silhouette, broad irregular native outline; (14) armored shoulder casting with exposed mounting foot, about 2:1; (15) deep vent hood with protruding exhaust lip, about 1.5:1; (16) sheared scute fragment with jagged mechanical edge and exposed rib stub, irregular silhouette.

CRITICAL EXTRACTION RULES: the #22F01F green must remain perfectly flat and unshaded right up to every component edge; no green bounce light, green outline, halo, vignette, floor, contact shadow, or ambient gradient. Put all lighting and contact occlusion inside each mechanical component. Every cell has one connected assembly; bolts/cables must remain visibly attached so connected-component extraction keeps the whole part. No square card backing.

Create a second production source board for reusable 2.5D game-environment COMPONENT CUTOUTS from HULLBREAKER's colossal machine-creature ship MERIDIAN. This sheet is the service/defense/tell companion to the supplied structural component style.

LAYOUT: exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, 16 equal conceptual cells. Use a completely flat, uniform chroma-key background color #22F01F across the entire canvas. NO drawn grid, no cell borders, no boxes, no frames, no plates behind parts, no cast shadows on the green background. Each cell contains exactly ONE connected mechanical assembly, isolated, centered, generous safe margin, never crossing cell boundaries. Use the component's natural silhouette and NATIVE ASPECT RATIO rather than square-card filling. Strict orthographic/front-facing presentation.

STYLE: cold oxidized teal steel, restrained burnt-copper wear/fasteners, deep mechanical recesses, painterly low-poly hard-surface realism consistent with supplied Meridian sheets. Strong silhouette and material separation at tiny gameplay scale. No text, numbers, icons, UI, labels, runes, generic neon, foliage, slime, infection growth, fantasy ornament, background scenery, or green reflection/spill. Humans/RIG are the detected infection; Meridian is coherent defense machinery. Ambient emission off. A few active-tell parts may contain ONE tiny physically housed amber or magenta-white lamp, no bloom or glow halo.

EXACT COMPONENT ORDER left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
ROW 1 — OBSERVE / SERVICE: (1) compact sensor hood with hinged diagnostic eyelid, native ~1.5:1; (2) long diagnostic shutter blade with visible hinge shoe, ~3:1; (3) small scan-iris mechanism without square backing, circular silhouette with three mounting tabs; (4) wake relay with attached mechanical feelers and one tiny housed amber telltale.
ROW 2 — INTERCEPT / CONTAIN: (5) opposed route-clamp jaw assembly with open center, wide silhouette; (6) long sliding interlock rail with two armored stops, ~4:1; (7) deployable pressure-organ cross brace with central piston, X silhouette; (8) closed defense-emplacement socket petals with three attached mount claws, no square backing.
ROW 3 — QUARANTINE / STERILIZE: (9) overlapping bulkhead seal segment, long horizontal ~3:1; (10) landing-denial tooth strip with six raised mechanical teeth, long ~4:1; (11) protruding armored purge nozzle with shut louver mouth, native ~1.5:1; (12) kill-lattice power junction with four attached conduit arms and four tiny housed magenta-white status nodes, cross silhouette.
ROW 4 — SCUTTLE / SPENT RESPONSE: (13) overdriven armor clamp with bent piston, tall narrow silhouette; (14) sheared scute pair with exposed attached rib bundle, irregular wide silhouette; (15) severed conduit cluster with torn attached collars, irregular branching silhouette; (16) spent purge iris ring with scorched attached armor tabs, circular irregular silhouette.

CRITICAL EXTRACTION RULES: #22F01F green stays flat/unshaded right up to component edges; no green bounce, outline, halo, vignette, floor, contact shadow, or ambient gradient. Keep lighting/contact occlusion inside each component. Every cell has one connected assembly; bolts, feelers, cables, arms and teeth must remain visibly attached so connected-component extraction keeps the whole part. NO SQUARE CARD BACKING.
